description: The local tab-strip webview (label "official-chat-strip") renders the official-chat window's tab bar from the SPA route index.html?chatstrip=1. It keeps window.__TAURI__ — chat-fingerprint.js is not injected here — so it can invoke official_chat_tabs to read the fixed tab list and switch_official_chat_tab to switch the active content webview. No remote matcher, so only this local webview in the official-chat window gets the grant; the remote content webviews (chat.deepseek.com / www.qianwen.com / agent.minimaxi.com) keep needing official-chat-remote.json instead.
